name: si-seo
description: Motor de SEO e Linter de Conteúdo em Tempo Real para WordPress (Gutenberg) e React

scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'package/si-seo/dist' | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'plugin/si-seo.php' -Destination 'package/si-seo/'; Copy-Item 'dist/*' -Destination 'package/si-seo/dist/'; Compress-Archive -Path 'package/si-seo' -DestinationPath 'si-seo.zip' -Force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'package'"
